notes: Fixed the Hostinger auto-fill (Settings → Email Senders' "Login" button) not actually working: it was handing the credentials to the extension via a CustomEvent, which does not reliably carry its payload across Chrome's page/content-script boundary. Switched to window.postMessage, the correct mechanism for this. Also removed the email from the URL of the tab it opens — both email and password now travel only through the same private, extension-only channel as the password did, and are deleted the instant they're used.
